issue_context.body:
The present_eco ist not available in Homeassistent 
Only boost and automatic

It seas to work for others, maybe older version

https://community.home-assistant.io/t/homematic-ip-mode-integration-eco-boost-manual-auto/84753

     PRESET_ECO, 
     PRESET_NONE,

     ClimateEntityFeature,

`hvac_modes:
  - auto

review_comments:
It would be great to test setting `PRESET_ECO` at `test_hmip_heating_group_heat`:
https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/tests/components/homematicip_cloud/test_climate.py#L39

Something like:
```
    await hass.services.async_call(
        "climate",
        "set_preset_mode",
        {"entity_id": entity_id, "preset_mode": PRESET_ECO},
        blocking=True,
    )
    assert len(hmip_device.mock_calls) == service_call_counter + X
    assert hmip_device.mock_calls[-1][0] == "set_control_mode"
    assert hmip_device.mock_calls[-1][1] == ("HMIP_ECO_CM",)
    await async_manipulate_test_data(hass, hmip_device, "controlMode", "ECO")
    ha_state = hass.states.get(entity_id)
    assert ha_state.attributes[ATTR_PRESET_MODE] == PRESET_ECO
```
Can we add here which state the entity has? As in it looks in the code above as this preset is actually a mode for the device in real life?
The state should be Auto. Should i add an assert statement to check that?
Yes. Both before and after setting the preset would be ideal to see that the state doesn't change.
